heading: Purposes
lead: The purposes of this chapter are to encourage—

tree.text: conservation of energy supplied by electric utilities;
the optimization of the efficiency of use of facilities and resources by electric utilities; and

notes.text: References in TextThis chapter, referred to in text, was in the original “this title”, meaning title I (§ 101 et seq.) of Pub. L. 95–617, Nov. 9, 1978, 92 Stat. 3120, which enacted subchapters I to IV of this chapter and section 6808 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, and amended sections 6802 to 6807 of Title 42. For complete classification of title I to the Code, see Tables.
